items.title: Supermarket hostage situation in Colombia's Cartagena disrupts incoming flights
items.summary: Armed robbers took several people hostage at a supermarket in Colombia’s tourist city of Cartagena on Tuesday, prompting a major police operation and the temporary suspension of incoming flights, authorities said. Landings at Rafael Nunez airport resumed about 45 minutes later, after the military used a runway during the operation.
